definition: A confabulation, also known as a false, degraded, or corrupted memory, is a stable pattern of activation in an artificial neural network or neural assembly that does not correspond to any previously learned patterns.
details: The same term is also applied to the human neural mistake-making process leading to a false memory.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Confabulation (neural networks).
